decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, and the lack of observations since 2019 gives no evidence that its value cannot be realized.
The marine box cooler line has shown signals of strong market share, so the option appears to be paying off and deserves continued commitment.
The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler line and is cheap to maintain, so keeping the option open is justified despite limited evidence of results.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established capabilities with low holding costs, and nothing observed shows its value is unrealizable.
Finned tubes support the firm's broader air cooler business, so the option is inexpensive to hold and strategically useful.
